articles.title: California Jury Swiftly Rejects Elon Musk's Lawsuit Against OpenAI
articles.summary: A California jury unanimously dismissed Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman. The jury found Musk filed too late, after the statute of limitations expired. The trial featured dramatic testimony from both tech leaders.

articles.title: NextEra's $67 Billion Bid for Dominion: AI's Insatiable Hunger for Power
articles.summary: NextEra Energy plans to acquire Dominion Energy in a $67 billion all-stock deal, aiming to create the world's largest regulated utility. The merger is fueled by surging electricity demand from AI data centers, even as consumer bills rise.

articles.title: How a Wayward Tortoise Named Rex United a Phoenix Suburb
articles.summary: A giant sulcata tortoise escaped and lumbered down a Scottsdale, Arizona street, sparking a neighborhood rescue mission. The incident highlights the challenges of keeping a species that can weigh 200 pounds and live 150 years.
